title: Member Handbook — Escorts, Young Riders and Pharmacy Stops on RideLink Trips
content:
This clause of the Non-Emergency Medical Transportation chapter governs who may ride with a member and when a pharmacy stop may be added. The numbers named are the RideLink level's own escort and stop terms.

**Clause.** Up to the level's escort allowance of escorts ride free; a member younger than the level's escort age must travel with an adult escort, and a trip for such a member without one is not booked. Where the level allows a pharmacy stop, one pharmacy stop of at most the level's longest stop in minutes may be added to the return leg of a medical trip without using a value-added trip.

## Restated as conditions

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Escorts riding are within the level's escort allowance | They ride free |
| The member is younger than the escort age and an adult escort travels | The age condition is met |
| The member is younger than the escort age and no adult escort travels | The trip is not booked |
| The level allows a pharmacy stop and the stop is on the return leg of a medical trip, within the longest stop | One such stop may be added, without using a value-added trip |

## Questions the clause answers

- **Does a pharmacy stop on the way home use up a value-added trip?** No, where the level allows the stop and it is one stop on the return leg of a medical trip.
- **May the stop be made on the outbound leg?** The clause allows the stop on the return leg of a medical trip.
- *Hypothetical:* on a level with an escort age of 18, a member aged 16 travels with an adult escort, so the trip may be booked as far as this clause is concerned; the same member travelling alone is not booked.
